scope: Legacy B3 is mandatory; shared B2/B3 workflows are in scope, with B2-only or synthetic evidence explicitly separated. GE means accepted native current core, not the older straight ge-beam3 facade.

rows.area: Factory, topology, DOF mapping
rows.detail: beam selects B2; quadratic_beam selects B3. Native GE uses separate owned factories; generic FEModel parity is not conferred by ge-beam3 (the older straight facade).

rows.area: Straight geometry, Q2 interpolation and axis conventions
rows.detail: Legacy straight-sided B3 and section-axis conventions have direct tests. Native straight/regular-curved definitions are accepted only with physical triad authority; implicit legacy roll must not be copied blindly.

rows.area: Reference linear stiffness, rigid modes and slender response
rows.detail: Keep existing GE algebra/slenderness acceptance. Integration tests need actual assembly and engineering response; do not demand identical element matrices from different discretizations.

rows.area: Standard isotropic sections and coupled SPD section protocol
rows.detail: Legacy area/Iy/Iz/J/shear factors and external GeneralizedBeamSection protocol are not identical to native ellipsoid/fibre types. Provide explicit elastic/stateful adapters, including physical orientation and mass ownership.

rows.area: Orthotropy, directional shear, torsion and Hill recovery
rows.detail: An anisotropic native resultant law is not automatic parity with the existing orthotropic material/fibre/Hill utilization contract. Map actual constitutive and physical recovery semantics.

rows.area: Section eccentricity, mass centre and rotary inertia
rows.detail: Native physical inertia and one eccentric joint do not establish every legacy section-offset/mass-summary combination.

rows.area: Generic static assembly, multiple RHS and solver caches
rows.detail: Native model-owned static solutions exist. General FEModel assembly, heterogeneous graph ownership and solver cache contracts must consume the current core explicitly.

rows.area: Partial rotational supports and prescribed motion
rows.detail: Native ordinary supports are homogeneous and rotational triples all fixed or all free. Translation control does not supply general prescribed rotations/partial hinges.

rows.area: Affine/multilevel MPC, shared rotations and constraints
rows.detail: Legacy multilevel beam constraints have direct B2 fixtures. Native owners explicitly reject constraint_equations; shared SO(3) rotations require an objective constraint contract.

rows.area: Mixed sections, beam networks and mixed element models
rows.detail: One native family per owner, no arbitrary mixed FEModel. Generalized and physical-fibre families and multiple shell connections need shared ownership without fallback.

rows.area: Nodal force/moment, gravity and load combinations
rows.detail: Native nodal/dead-line programmes are scoped. Integrate LoadCase/LoadCombination, density-based gravity, reference measures and reaction accounting; B2 gravity coverage is not B3 proof.

rows.area: General distributed beam loads/couples and follower classes
rows.detail: Native line/couple programmes exist; frozen inventory does not establish a general legacy distributed/follower BEAM load API. Shell follower-pressure tests do not prove it. Enumerate actual load entry points before expanding the obligation.

rows.area: Von Karman nonlinear force/tangent and P-delta
rows.detail: Legacy B3 elastic/fibre tangents and P-delta have direct tests; native operators need general solver integration, not substitution by legacy kinematics.

rows.area: Corotational rigid motion and large-rotation beam response
rows.detail: Legacy corotational fibre tests include both topologies. Preserve GE multiplicative rotations and admitted finite static evidence; legacy generalized B3 corotational exception is U02.

rows.area: Physical fibre plasticity and loading/unloading/reversal
rows.detail: Native physical fibre and resultant laws already support scoped histories. Missing work is external material/section contract parity, cross-family models and normal solver use, not redoing accepted histories.

rows.area: Initial stress/strain and staged material history
rows.detail: Legacy initial-field admissibility and provenance are tested with beam fibres. General initial-field injection into native owned histories is not accepted by the published API; no checkpoint resealing.

rows.area: Newton, line search, force/displacement/arc controls
rows.detail: Dedicated GE drivers exist; unify ordinary dispatch, cutback, affine prescribed motion and accepted state ownership. Generic restart/arc tests use a spring and are explicitly not beam qualification.

rows.area: General restart, serialization, cancellation and rollback
rows.detail: Native authenticated restart/durable replay already works. Integrate general checkpoint/result contracts and establish scalable continuation without weakening old immutable checkpoints. Element.to_dict alone is not a history checkpoint.

rows.area: Station recovery, fibre stresses and common result objects
rows.detail: Legacy B3 station histories and weighted resultants are tested. Connect native objective recovery to standard FE results/visualization without inventing stresses for resultant-only sections.

rows.area: Consistent mass and physical mass summaries
rows.detail: Retain physical GE internal inertia; do not substitute static Schur reduction for dynamics. General mass assembly and summary protocols need integration.

rows.area: Nodal point mass and distributed edge mass
rows.detail: Point mass has direct B2 modal tests; native owner rejects point_masses. Distributed edge mass is an API to inventory separately, not established by the point-mass test.

rows.area: Reference and current-rest modal analysis
rows.detail: Legacy beam qualification and B2 free modes are covered; native scoped reference/current-rest pencils exist. General sparse modal, mixed graphs and mode selection need integration; active-yield states are not silently conservative.

rows.area: Geometric stiffness, prestress and eigenvalue buckling
rows.detail: B3 Euler and both-topology section Kg tests exist. Native frozen-current buckling is scoped; integrate common prestress consumers and constraints while preserving conservative-state restrictions.

rows.area: Damping, linear transient and prescribed time histories
rows.detail: Legacy Newmark and activity-scaled Rayleigh damping tests exercise B2. Native current-rest modes do not establish transient solver parity; preserve physical internal coordinates.

rows.area: Finite-velocity finite-rotation dynamics
rows.detail: Legacy transient/contact availability is not proof of objective finite-rotation inertia or gyroscopic terms. Native release excludes this domain. Freeze an independent dynamics extension if the user requires it, rather than relabel legacy tests.

rows.area: Beam contact/impact and beam fracture
rows.detail: Opt-in beam-segment contact and beam erosion have explicit B2 fixtures. Need B3 baseline confirmation and native contact/inertia/state integration. Capacity-based damage skips beam targets (U06).

rows.area: Activity, softening and hard deletion
rows.detail: Generated-beam activity scales K/M/C and hard deletion removes contributions without topology deletion. Native owner rejects activity; preserve rollback and accepted-state/provenance semantics.

rows.area: General beam-shell joints, eccentric stiffeners and plastic coupling
rows.detail: Legacy generated coupling metadata/MPC routes exist. Accepted GE connection is one owned elastic Q4/S3 plus generalized beam; multiple joints and plastic/fibre-shell coupling remain open.

rows.area: Production size, sparse assembly, sessions and reuse
rows.detail: Native owner caps 16 elements with restricted N32. General sessions/caches exist in legacy framework; no unlimited-size guarantee is inferred. Qualify larger graphs, sparse paths and bounded restart/recovery cost before changing guards.

rows.area: Scalar/batch dispatch and performance diagnostics
rows.detail: Legacy B3 batch/scalar equality is directly tested. Release preserved B2/B3 timing baseline, not GE production throughput parity. Native batching is optional if scalar route meets defined application needs.

rows.area: Generated model adapters and application routing
rows.detail: ANYsolver generated-geometry/ANYstructure-mode tests are not current ANYfem/ANYstructure UI qualification. Freeze sibling-specific adapter/test inventories before their integration; no sibling modifications in this step.

rows.area: Limit points and postbuckling from a genuine loading path
rows.detail: Legacy tests demonstrate stopping near a limit point, not general stable postbuckling. GE signed/seeded unstable branches remain valid but cannot certify a stable from-rest path. Separate continuation parity from a new stable-branch claim.

rows.area: Curved midside legacy B3
rows.detail: Legacy B3 rejects curved reference geometry. Native regular curved Q2 is an existing additional capability, not a missing legacy requirement.

rows.area: Generalized-section corotational legacy B3
rows.detail: B3 rejects this combination; B2 generalized corotational support does not transfer to B3. Native coupled-section finite rotation may exceed the B3 baseline.

rows.area: Generalized section plus legacy fibre-plasticity option
rows.detail: Legacy constructors reject mixing generalized_section and fiber_plasticity. Explicit native section laws remain separate; no contradictory combination is required for parity.

rows.area: Legacy corotational static fracture combination
rows.detail: The legacy nonlinear-static corotational scope test rejects fracture. This does not erase the separate supported B2 impact-erosion route.

rows.area: Physical stress from arbitrary generalized resultants; nonspatial mass summary
rows.detail: Legacy generalized recovery deliberately lacks physical/von-Mises stress and nonspatial inertia cannot define physical mass summaries. Preserve those distinctions in GE adapters.

rows.area: Capacity-based damage for beam contact targets
rows.detail: Legacy emits an explicit warning that this damage model skips beams. It is distinct from beam fracture/erosion. Do not call shell capacity tests beam qualification.

rows.area: Inherited compute_internal_forces placeholder
rows.detail: B2/B3 inherit Element.compute_internal_forces returning zeros. Physical force parity must use overridden compute_nonlinear_response, not reproduce the placeholder. Source assertion only; no dedicated legacy regression was found.

rows.area: Hinge/end-release object and thermal load API
rows.detail: Partial boundary restraints/MPCs are real requirements (P08/P09). A dedicated end-release or thermal-beam API and its B3 tests are not established by this audit. Do not turn generic shell/load tests into a legacy support claim.

rows.area: General history checkpoint through Element.to_dict
rows.detail: Element.to_dict exports ID/class/nodes/material only, not nonlinear history or full section definition. Real checkpoint parity belongs to P18.

rows.area: Free dead-prestress pencil without descending geometric operator
rows.detail: Legacy explicitly rejects a free-free buckling pencil whose geometric operator does not descend to the quotient. Parity must preserve valid-domain rejection, not force eigenvalues from an inadmissible problem.
